freshness.rule: Ready evidence is valid only for the exact immutable Care candidate source revision and exact package checksum it names. Any source, package, recovery-script, dependency, or target-environment change invalidates prior ready evidence until lifecycle acceptance is repeated.

failure_behavior.summary_rule: The Care continuity summary must never be more favorable than any required exact-candidate restore-capability evidence. Missing, failed, stale, mismatched, or malformed lifecycle evidence blocks ready.

restore_capability: Exact candidate Debian package installs and passes installed validation on the representative supported target.
Candidate removal succeeds and package-owned executable, helper, policy, desktop, icon, and metadata paths are absent afterward.
Exact candidate reinstalls and passes installed validation.
A retained previous Development package can be installed with an explicit downgrade and the previous runtime/report path remains functional.
The exact candidate can be restored after downgrade and passes installed validation again.
Final installed state matches the exact candidate package version, source revision, and recorded package SHA-256.
migration: Upgrade and downgrade behavior is exercised for the exact candidate against a retained prior Development package.
Care continues to persist no substantial application-owned user dataset requiring a separate data migration.
documentation: Current recovery documentation records irreversible maintenance boundaries and package rollback behavior.
Current release-acceptance documentation records the exact-candidate recovery and rollback qualification gate.
provenance: Exact Debian package SHA-256 is recorded and matches the accepted artifact.
Exact validation workflow run and retained artifact identity are recorded.
The accepted package is built from the GoreeCloud/goreecloud-zorin-os Care component authority.
